answer: Each identity locks a 70-credit bond and keeps one bridge across a lagoon. Each epoch, random pairing sends each keeper across the other's bridge to log deck serial, lagoon level, meadow landing. Bad logs or missed crossings burn the bond. An extra identity needs its own bridge and partner: filings cost 38+6(k-1), the 1,000th 6,032, so 1,000 fakes pay 3,035,000. One log cannot serve two keys, so rented crossings fail. Honest keepers pay 38 once.
